[[Municipal Auditorium (Kansas City, Missouri)|Municipal Auditorium]] }} {{2018–19 WAC men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 UMKC Kangaroos men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Missouri–Kansas City]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Kangaroos, led by sixth-year head coach [[Kareem Richardson]], played their home conference games on-campus at [[Swinney Recreation Center]] and home non-conference games off-campus at [[Municipal Auditorium (Kansas City, Missouri)|Municipal Auditorium]] in [[Kansas City, Missouri]] as a member of the [[Western Athletic Conference|Western Athletic Conference (WAC)]]. The Kangaroos finished the season 11–21, 6–10 in WAC play to finish in a tie for seventh place. They were defeated by [[Utah Valley University]] in the [[2019 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]] quarterfinal round. Following the elimination in the conference tournament, Richardson was told he would not lead the program for a seventh season.{{Cite news|access-date=November 2, 2024|language=en|publisher=Coaches Database|title=UMKC, George Washington and Appalachian State head coaches fired|url=https://www.coachesdatabase.com/richardson-joseph-fox-fired/|website=www.coachesdatabase.com}} == Previous season == The Kangaroos finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] with a record of 10–22 overall, 10–6 in conference to finish in a tie for sixth place. ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header |high_school = yes |sex = m |team = UMKC Kangaroos |teamcolors = y |year = 2018 }} {{CBB roster/Player | pos = C/F | num = 30 | first = Aleer | last = Leek | dab = | link = | note = | inj = | cur_rs = | ft = 6 | in = 9 | lbs = 225 | rs = | class = Sr | high_school = Victory Rock Prep/
